summary: Iteration 71 - Editorial Calendar, ICS-Auto-Email, News Push Refactor: All 15 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend tests verified EditorialCalendar dialog with all navigation controls, legend showing 6 statuses, and clicking calendar posts opens NewsEditorDialog for editing.
critical_code_review_comments: NEWS: GET /api/news/editorial-calendar returns {start, end, total, items[]} with calendar_date for each post
NEWS: Editorial calendar respects start/end query params for date filtering
NEWS: Editorial calendar returns owner_id, owner_name, channels, priority for each item
NEWS: Editorial calendar returns 403 for users without news.create or news.moderate capability
MEETINGS: POST /api/meetings/{id}/send-invitations manually sends ICS email invites
MEETINGS: send-invitations with no recipients returns {total:0, sent:0, failed:0, reason:'no_recipients'}
MEETINGS: send-invitations with specific emails array sends to those emails only
MEETINGS: send-invitations returns 403 for non-host users
MEETINGS: POST /api/meetings with invited_emails and meeting_type=scheduled triggers fire-and-forget ICS dispatch
NEWS: POST /api/news/push/send still works after refactor to services/news_push.py
FRONTEND: 'Redaktions-Kalender' button visible for users with news.create capability (data-testid='open-editorial-calendar')
FRONTEND: EditorialCalendar dialog opens with data-testid='editorial-calendar-dialog'
FRONTEND: Calendar grid (data-testid='cal-grid') shows 7-column weekly layout
FRONTEND: Navigation buttons: cal-prev, cal-next, cal-today, cal-weeks-select (4/6/12 weeks), cal-close all present
FRONTEND: Legend (data-testid='cal-legend') shows all 6 statuses: Entwurf, Pruefung, Freigabe, Geplant, Live, Archiviert
FRONTEND: Clicking calendar post (data-testid='cal-post-{id}') opens NewsEditorDialog for editing
seed_data_creation: Test data created during tests was cleaned up via fixture teardown
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 71 tested: (1) NEWS editorial-calendar - GET /api/news/editorial-calendar returns posts with calendar_date, respects start/end params, returns owner_info (owner_id, owner_name, channels, priority), 403 for unauthorized. (2) MEETINGS send-invitations - POST /api/meetings/{id}/send-invitations manually sends ICS invites, returns {total, sent, failed}, supports specific emails array, returns reason='no_recipients' when empty, 403 for non-host. (3) MEETINGS auto-ICS - POST /api/meetings with invited_emails and meeting_type=scheduled triggers fire-and-forget ICS dispatch. (4) NEWS push refactor - POST /api/news/push/send still works via services/news_push.py wrapper. (5) FRONTEND EditorialCalendar - Button 'Redaktions-Kalender' visible for news.create users, dialog opens with cal-grid, navigation (prev/next/today/weeks-select/close), legend with 6 statuses, clicking post opens NewsEditorDialog. (6) REGRESSION - scheduled publish coercion, participant_count (instant=1, scheduled=0), soft-cancel series, cleanup endpoint all still working.

mocked_apis.resend_sandbox: Resend email delivery is in test-mode; ICS invites may show failed=1 unless sending to verified test email (selim@adilovic.de). This is expected behavior, NOT a code bug.
